targets.name: local
targets.startCommand: CITE_OR_DIE_APP_ENV=test CITE_OR_DIE_DATA_DIR=/tmp/cite-or-die-e2e CITE_OR_DIE_AUTH_SECRET=test-secret-with-at-least-32-bytes uv run --extra dev uvicorn cite_or_die.api.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
targets.notes: Local seeded-test target for diligence workflow proof.

auth.secretsPolicy: Do not commit credentials, cookies, tokens, or private session dumps.

dataMode.prodPolicy: Production data requires explicit approval and is read-only unless exact writes are separately approved.

automation.notes: Run after starting the local test server target.

commands: uvicorn console output from the local test server
logging.notes: Runner writes browser-observed warnings and errors to events.jsonl.

commands: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/integration/test_diligence_ui.py tests/integration/test_diligence_api.py
regression.notes: Targeted UI/API checks for the diligence workflow.
